case: SQLite numeric-affinity grid and CSV parsing preserve nonnumeric TEXT and reject lossy numeric-looking inputs
contract: SQLite INTEGER, REAL and NUMERIC grid edits retain clearly nonnumeric input as TEXT; MySQL and SQL Server remain strict.
Overflowing integers, floating overflow and excess decimal precision are rejected before SQLite affinity can round them.
Native SQLite typeof() confirms TEXT storage and untouched sibling rows retain native classes/values; shared CSV import uses the same fallback boundary.
